metas.name: Parks and Recreation
metas.description: Like Ted Lasso and Community, this is a heartwarming ensemble comedy with a positive message and high-energy humor.

metas.name: The IT Crowd
metas.description: A staple of British comedy that shares the awkward social humor of Peep Show and the tech-centric wit of Silicon Valley.

metas.name: Solar Opposites
metas.description: Created by the Rick and Morty team, this offers the same sci-fi absurdity and fast-paced animation style.

metas.name: Spaced
metas.description: A cult classic British comedy full of pop-culture references that heavily influenced the meta-style of Community.

metas.name: Ghosts (UK)
metas.description: A charming, funny, and heartwarming ensemble comedy that provides the same comfort as Ted Lasso.

metas.name: The Orville
metas.description: A sci-fi adventure that balances humor and heart, sitting perfectly between Futurama and Doctor Who.

metas.name: Superstore
metas.description: A relatable and diverse workplace comedy that serves as great background viewing, similar to Scrubs.

metas.name: Malcolm in the Middle
metas.description: Since you watched the 2026 special, the original series is the gold standard for chaotic, funny family dynamics.

metas.name: Harley Quinn
metas.description: An adult animated series that is violent, hilarious, and subverts the superhero genre like One-Punch Man.

metas.name: Flight of the Conchords
metas.description: A charming and musical comedy about a New Zealand duo that fits the quirky, low-key vibe of New Girl.
